idea-plugin.name: FastORM Builder
idea-plugin.description:
FastORM Builder — The fastest way to go from database schema to production-ready ORM code.

Powered by a fully embedded web UI (JCEF) — connections, settings, and generation all in one fluid interface.

Supports 12 ORM frameworks across Java and JavaScript/TypeScript:
Java: MyBatis, JPA, Hibernate, YORM
JS/TS: Sequelize, Knex.js, Prisma, TypeORM, Bookshelf.js, Waterline, Objection.js, MikroORM

Works in all JetBrains IDEs — IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PhpStorm, PyCharm, and more.

Supported Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQLite, DuckDB.

Key Features:
  • 🌐 Modern embedded web UI — no legacy dialogs
  • ⚡ One-click code generation from database tables and views
  • 🔄 Language selector: Java / JavaScript with ORM dropdown
  • 📝 JS/TS output toggle for all JavaScript ORM generators
  • ⚠️ Overwrite protection — warns before replacing existing files
  • 🏗️ JPA/Hibernate relationship detection from foreign keys
  • 📦 Lombok @Data annotation support
  • 🕐 Generation history with full audit trail
  • 📋 "Copy as Executable SQL" from MyBatis log output
  • ▶️ Run MyBatis Generator with official XML configuration
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.9.3 — Multi-IDE support (2024.1+), view support with distinct icons, 12 ORM frameworks (Java + JS/TS), language selector, overwrite protection.
